sources.entry: Checkout my list of management resources.

summary.one_liner: A curated, annotated link list of engineering management books, articles, talks, job ladders and blogs, organized by management topic.
summary.what_it_does: This is a reading list rather than software: it collects links to books, articles, slides, podcasts, videos and newsletters about engineering management. The README is organized as a long table of contents, with sections for books, general management resources, and about 80 topics such as 1-1s, hiring, career growth and job ladders, culture, decisions, feedback, delegation, change management and CTO/VP roles. Many entries carry the author's short notes or quoted takeaways, and some items are marked as must-reads or as personal favorites. Icons flag item types (book, video, slides, podcast) and must-reads. The visible portion also includes curated examples of company career ladders and a list of lists pointing to other reading collections. The README is truncated, so later sections such as the hiring subsections and the newsletter and blog lists were not fully visible.
use_cases: Finding books on managing software engineers
Looking up career ladder examples for engineers
Reading about hiring and interviewing technical staff
Preparing for a first-time manager role
Finding engineering manager newsletters and podcasts
notable: Topic-by-topic index covering about 80 engineering management subjects
Annotated entries with quoted takeaways from books and articles
Curated collection of company career ladder and engineering levels examples
Icons marking item types and must-read picks
caveats: Contains links and summaries only; no software to install
The author states they do not necessarily agree with everything listed
README is truncated in the provided text, so some sections were not visible
